itemB: Most durable (natural slate / standing seam metal)

verdict.winner: 3-tab asphalt shingles lead on lowest install cost; natural slate and standing seam metal lead on durability, with architectural asphalt shingles the runner-up balancing cost against a 30-year life.
verdict.reasoning: 3-tab asphalt shingles lead on entry price at $5.50-$9.50 per NJ square foot (Josten Roofing), but their 20-year life forces more re-roof cycles than natural slate at 60-150 years or standing seam metal at 40-80 years (InterNACHI chart) -- so a sourced install range divided across a sourced lifespan narrows the cheapest gap on a long hold.
verdict.alternate: Architectural asphalt shingles serve the middle ground -- $6.50-$11.00 per NJ square foot over a 30-year life (Josten Roofing and the InterNACHI chart) -- recouping ~61% of job cost at resale versus metal's ~49% (Remodeling/Zonda 2023 Cost vs Value report), which favors them when a near-term sale leads the decision.

keyFacts: 3-tab asphalt shingles install cheapest at $5.50-$9.50 per NJ square foot over a 20-year life (Josten Roofing and the InterNACHI chart).
Architectural asphalt shingles install at $6.50-$11.00 per NJ square foot over a 30-year life (Josten Roofing and the InterNACHI chart).
EPDM (flat roof) installs at $7.00-$10.00 per NJ square foot over a 15-25-year life (Josten Roofing and the InterNACHI chart).
TPO (flat roof) installs at $8.00-$12.00 per NJ square foot over a 7-20-year life (Josten Roofing and the InterNACHI chart).
Wood / cedar installs at $10-$20+ per square foot over a 25-year life (NHI and the InterNACHI chart).
Standing seam metal installs at $9.00-$16.00+ per NJ square foot over a 40-80-year life, with copper 70+ years (Josten Roofing and the InterNACHI chart).
Natural slate installs at $10-$30 per NJ square foot and lasts longest at 60-150 years (NJ roofing guides and the InterNACHI chart).

Cost per year divides a sourced install range by a sourced lifespan -- an illustrative method, not a measured figure -- spreading the NJ $10,000-$25,000 replacement benchmark across a 20-year asphalt life or a 60-year slate life (HomeAdvisor, Modernize, and the InterNACHI chart).
Labor runs roughly 60% of an asphalt project cost (HomeGuide).
A full NJ asphalt roof replacement falls within the $10,000-$25,000 benchmark (HomeAdvisor and Modernize).
Natural slate tiles can be replaced indefinitely while the deck and fasteners stay sound, making the covering itself rarely the lifespan limiter (InterNACHI chart and the National Slate Association).
Standing seam metal uses concealed fasteners that leak less than exposed-fastener systems (InterNACHI chart).
Actual asphalt and metal roof life varies up to plus or minus 40% with climate, install, and maintenance (NRCA).
Attic ventilation extends roof life up to 25% by reducing heat-driven volatile loss and thermal cycling (NRCA).
Wood / cedar needs fungicide or algaecide every few years at $0.15-$0.60 per square foot, plus a 1.5-inch air space beneath the shakes for drying (HomeGuide and the Cedar Shake & Shingle Bureau).
Standing seam metal with a reflective finish reduces peak cooling demand 11-27% in air-conditioned residential buildings (EPA) -- a peak-demand effect, not a year-round bill reduction.
A reflective roof stays over 50 degrees F cooler than a conventional roof on a sunny afternoon (DOE).
Architectural asphalt shingles recoup ~61% of job cost at resale and standing seam metal ~49% (Remodeling/Zonda 2023 Cost vs Value report).
National roof replacement recoups 60-68% of cost at sale (Remodeling/Zonda 2023 Cost vs Value report and Zillow analysis via Opendoor).
3-tab asphalt shingles last 20 years and architectural asphalt shingles 30 years, while metal lasts 40-80 and slate 60-150 years (InterNACHI chart).

njContext: NJ roofing costs run ~10-40% above national averages on higher labor, stricter code, and older housing stock needing extra decking work (industry consensus).
NJ per-square-foot ranges: asphalt $5.50-$11.00, metal $9.00-$16.00+, slate $10-$30 (Josten Roofing and NJ roofing guides).
A full NJ roof replacement falls within the $10,000-$25,000 benchmark (HomeAdvisor and Modernize).
Coastal NJ communities add 15-20% over inland on salt-air exposure (Angi and HomeAdvisor regional data).
A re-roof of asphalt, metal, or slate on a detached 1- or 2-family dwelling is treated as ordinary maintenance with no permit, inspection, or notice (N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7 and the NJ DCA 2018 alert).
Commercial roof work exceeding 25% of roof area in 12 months triggers a NJ UCC permit (N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7(c)).

For Essex County houses: 3-tab asphalt suits short-hold/budget-led owners at $5.50-$9.50/sq ft; standing seam metal and natural slate suit long-hold (40+ year) owners on a 40-80- or 60-150-year life (Josten Roofing and the InterNACHI chart).
Commercial low-slope: EPDM at $7.00-$10.00/sq ft (15-25 yr; seam separation is dominant failure mode per NRCA); TPO at $8.00-$12.00/sq ft (7-20 yr; heat-welded seams, reflective white membrane).
positioning: Position Newark Quality Roofing as a registered New Jersey Home Improvement Contractor (N.J.S.A. 56:8-136), insured, offering a free written estimate -- never as a state-licensed roofer (NJ issues no roofing license) and never with manufacturer-certification tiers (no GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, or 'we are certified' claims). Frame warranties honestly as two parts: the manufacturer material warranty plus NQR's written contractor workmanship warranty -- not a cert-tier 'best warranty available' boast. Present cost-per-year strictly as an illustrative install-divided-by-lifespan method using sourced figures, never as an NQR-measured or guaranteed number. NQR provides a roof-material recommendation grounded in the named sources (Josten Roofing install ranges, InterNACHI lifespans, NRCA variance, Remodeling/Zonda resale data) and a free written estimate tailored to the homeowner's hold period and budget.
